text:
anna: quick question — opened PR that adds a lightweight metering header so SDKs can opt-in to per-request rate sampling: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482. cc @mike for console mapping.

mike: saw it. can you paste the header name & example payload? we need to confirm how it maps to the quota dashboard.

anna: header is `X-RW-Rate-Sample: 1` (boolean-ish) and optional `X-RW-Rate-Weight: <int>` for variable-cost requests. example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-RW-Rate-Sample: 1" -H "X-RW-Rate-Weight: 3" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

suresh: devex concern — this technically changes how SDKs calculate client-side quotas if we start trusting `X-RW-Rate-Weight`. is this an additive signal or a canonical one?

anna: intended as advisory for telemetry & dashboard attribution only. server quota engine still authoritative. SDKs would use it to show an "estimated quota" in the client and reduce local batching heuristics. not meant to gate requests.

mike: ok that helps. console needs two things: 1) a new ingestion pipeline field (`rate_weight`) to surface in the per-route matrix, 2) a migration plan so existing dashboards don't drop to zero when samples start coming in.

lia: for (2) could we backfill rate_weight=1 when header absent for the first 30 days? prevents noise while we onboard SDKs.

mike: backfill makes sense. but we need a flag so customers can opt-out if they prefer raw server-side counts. add a migration toggle in feature flags.

anna: implementation detail in the PR: SDKs will default to *not* sending the header. we'll flip opt-in at runtime via the client config. new major bump for clients?

suresh: bumping majors is painful. can we do it as a minor with opt-in param in constructor? e.g., `new RedwoodClient({ enableRateMetering: true })` — that way no breaking change.

anna: yep that's the plan. but note the runtime config requires serialized config to be present in some serverless use-cases; callouts in the README added.

mike: console telemetry team: when ingestion sees a header we tag the request. two UX asks: A) show a stacked bar: server-count vs client-estimate, B) expose a filter to only show header-tagged data.

lia: on the opt-out toggle — ops asked for a 2-week canary. they want to enable for 5% of accounts first. can we emit `X-RW-Rate-Canary: pct=5` so pipeline can route sample to a canary partition?

anna: we can add that header in the SDK, but it feels like leakage of rollout policy into the request. maybe the SDK should still send `X-RW-Rate-Sample: 1` and the client-side rollout agent (server) attaches `X-RW-Canary` before reaching ingestion. less client surface area.

mike: agreed — keep SDK headers minimal. console ingestion can apply canary partitioning server-side.

suresh: logging note — please add instrumentation so the SDK logs when the header is sent: `logger.info("rate-meter: sent", { weight: 3 })`. will help support lookups.

anna: added. also added a tiny unit test and an e2e that exercises the header in the local dev proxy.

console-bot: deploy pipeline: PR #482 queued. CI: unit tests passed, e2e failed on flakey network step (retrying).

mike: once CI is green we'll wire the ingestion mapping change and add the backfill job. lia can you own the dashboard tile?

lia: can do. plan: create new tile named "Estimated rate usage (client opt-in)" and include a tooltip explaining advisory nature. also add a small callout about opt-in % during rollout.

suresh: docs: add a compatibility note in SDK changelog — "no breaking changes; opt-in via constructor; header advisory only". also call out that server-side quotas remain authoritative.

anna: sounds good. final ask: anyone object if we flip the SDK default to off and ship as minor (0.12.0)?

mike: no objections. schedule: ship SDK minor tomorrow, console changes next week in two phases (ingest + dashboard). backfill runs during weekend window.

lia: i'll prepare the dashboard PR and a small release note draft for the console changelog.

anna: thanks all. i'll update PR with the constructor opt-in and add the logger test.

mike: thanks — tag me once CI is green and I'll kick off the ingestion deploy. :thumbsup:

anna: tagging to-dos: @mike (ingest mapping & backfill toggle), @lia (dashboard tile & tooltip), @suresh (SDK changelog blurb), @console-bot (CI monitoring).

console-bot: e2e retry succeeded, all checks passed. PR #482 merged into `main`."
